title: Ilmenite
description: &6Ilmenite&r is produced from centrifuging &6Titanium Ore&r. By itself, it can be placed in an Arc Furnace to produce 3 Titanium ingots, or, can be further processed in a Chemical Plant using &bTitanium Tetrachloride&r to further increase its yield. The most efficient recipe is in the &3Pyrolysis Oven&r, where on top of giving the most titanium per ilmenite, it also recycles back all the &bChlorine&r.
